answer: Whisper-relay bond: each identity locks 70 credits and files a voyage manifest with three relays. Each epoch a zephyr beacon publishes a fresh nonce; it must collect the three signatures in order in an hour, each stamped into a ripple ledger, or the bond burns. First route 45, the k-th 45+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,542,500 for a 40,000 pool. A rented-relay ring fails: relays stake 30, lost after five routes per epoch. An honest agent pays 45 once.
